questions.question: Which African country has Formula 1 announced will host a new grand prix from the early 2030s?
questions.explanation: Formula 1 announced that Kigali, Rwanda, will host a grand prix for at least ten years, marking the championship's first race in Africa since 1993.
questions.context: In auto racing, Formula 1 announces a new grand prix in Kigali, Rwanda, to run for at least 10 years starting in the early 2030s with a new track. This would be the first F1 grand prix in Africa since South Africa in 1993.

questions.question: Former gang leader Duane 'Keffe D' Davis received a prison sentence of at least 40 years for his role in the 1996 murder of which famous musician?
questions.explanation: A court in Nevada handed Davis a minimum term of four decades behind bars for planning the drive-by shooting of Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas.
questions.context: Murder of Tupac Shakur: The Clark County District Court in Nevada, United States, sentences former Crips gang leader Duane "Keffe D" Davis to a minimum of 40 years in prison for orchestrating the 1996 murder of rapper Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas.

questions.question: Which animals did wildlife authorities in Bali release back into the ocean after intercepting a smuggling boat?
questions.explanation: Indonesian officials returned twenty protected green sea turtles to the sea after rescuing them from a deserted smuggler vessel.
questions.context: Indonesian authorities release 20 protected green sea turtles back into the oceans off Bali after they were seized from an empty boat abandoned by wildlife smugglers last week.

questions.story: Russo-Ukrainian war > Bulgaria–Russia relations, Violations of non-combatant airspace during the Russo-Ukrainian war
questions.question: Which country summoned Russia's ambassador after commercial cargo vessels were attacked by drones off its Black Sea coast?
questions.explanation: Bulgarian Prime Minister Rumen Radev called in the Russian diplomat after two merchant ships were struck off the coast of Bulgaria.
questions.context: Russo-Ukrainian war > Bulgaria–Russia relations, Violations of non-combatant airspace during the Russo-Ukrainian war: Two merchant ships are hit by unknown drones off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast, with one sinking. Eleven crew members are missing and 20 in total are rescued. Bulgarian prime minister Rumen Radev has blamed Russia and summoned its ambassador. It is the second such attack in six days.

questions.question: Parliament in which European nation voted to overturn substantial parts of a controversial 2021 anti-LGBTQ child protection statute?
questions.explanation: The Hungarian National Assembly passed legislation rolling back most elements of the law that had been introduced during Viktor Orbán's tenure.
questions.context: LGBTQ rights in Hungary: The Hungarian National Assembly passes an amendment repealing most provisions of the anti-LGBTQ child protection law that was previously passed during former prime minister Viktor Orbán's tenure in 2021.
